tool_schemas.name: getVideoDetails
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached details for a single YouTube video (and refreshes from YouTube and upserts the cache when missing or stale), including core metadata and latest available statistics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the video identifier is missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks access to the backend, NOT_FOUND when the video does not exist or is not retrievable from YouTube, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream refresh is required but the YouTube API quota is exhausted. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when YouTube is temporarily unavailable or returns an unexpected response during refresh.

tool_schemas.name: searchVideos
tool_schemas.description: Searches YouTube for videos matching the provided query and returns a paged list of result items with basic metadata; results are returned in relevance order and use page tokens (next/prev) for pagination when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the query or pagination inputs are missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use search, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream YouTube search call is required but quota is exhausted. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when YouTube search fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: getTranscripts
tool_schemas.description: Returns transcripts/captions for the requested videos as text assets from cache, fetching and upserting missing/stale transcripts when possible, and returns results per video (including when a transcript is unavailable). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any video identifier is malformed or the batch is empty/too large, UNAUTHORIZED when transcript access is not permitted, and NOT_FOUND when a referenced video cannot be resolved in cache and is not retrievable upstream. Raises CONFLICT when transcripts are not available for a video (e.g., captions disabled/none) and the request requires a transcript, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR when an upstream fetch is needed but cannot be completed.

tool_schemas.name: getRelatedVideos
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of videos related to the specified seed video, using cached related lists when fresh and refreshing from YouTube recommendations when missing or stale; pagination is provided via page tokens when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the seed video identifier is missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot access related-video lookups, and NOT_FOUND when the seed video does not exist or cannot be retrieved. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream refresh is required but quota is exhausted, and UPSTREAM_ERROR on upstream failures.

tool_schemas.name: getChannelStatistics
tool_schemas.description: Returns cached statistics for multiple channels (e.g., subscriber_count, view_count, video_count) and refreshes missing/stale channel rows from YouTube before returning per-channel results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when channel identifiers are malformed or the request exceeds allowed batch limits, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to access channel stats, and NOT_FOUND when a channel cannot be resolved in cache and is not retrievable from YouTube. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh is required but YouTube quota is exhausted, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for upstream fetch failures.

tool_schemas.name: getChannelTopVideos
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of the channel’s top videos ordered by popularity (typically by view_count), served from cache when fresh and refreshed from YouTube when missing or stale; lists are paged using page tokens/limits when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the channel identifier or paging inputs are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot access channel video listings, and NOT_FOUND when the channel does not exist or cannot be retrieved. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream refresh is needed but quota is exhausted, and UPSTREAM_ERROR on upstream failures.

tool_schemas.name: getVideoEngagementRatio
tool_schemas.description: Returns per-video engagement metrics derived from cached statistics (e.g., view_count, like_count, comment_count) plus the computed engagement_ratio, refreshing missing/stale stats from YouTube when configured to do so. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any video identifier is malformed or batch limits are exceeded, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to read analytics, and NOT_FOUND when a video cannot be resolved in cache and is not retrievable upstream. Raises CONFLICT when an engagement ratio cannot be computed due to missing required stats (e.g., disabled likes/comments) and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR when a refresh is required but cannot be completed.

tool_schemas.name: getTrendingVideos
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of currently trending videos for the requested region and optional category, using cached trending snapshots when fresh and refreshing from YouTube when missing or stale; pagination is provided via page tokens/limits when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when region/category/paging inputs are invalid (including unsupported category IDs), UNAUTHORIZED when trending access is not permitted, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream refresh is required but YouTube quota is exhausted. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when YouTube trending retrieval fails.

tool_schemas.name: compareVideos
tool_schemas.description: Compares 2–50 videos by the requested metrics and returns a sorted side-by-side comparison table, accepting either YouTube video IDs or cached video row IDs and optionally including basic channel info; when listing-like output is produced it is fully returned for the requested set (no pagination) and respects sort_by/sort_order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when neither (or both) of youtube_video_ids/video_ids are provided, IDs fail validation, the list size is outside 2–50, metrics/sort inputs are invalid, or max_stale_seconds is negative; raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot access video analytics. Raises NOT_FOUND when any referenced video cannot be resolved (in cache or upstream when refresh=auto/force), CONFLICT when refresh=none is used but required cached stats are missing for the requested metrics, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR when refresh triggers upstream calls that cannot be completed.

youtube_video_ids.description: List of YouTube video IDs to compare (11-char YouTube IDs).

video_ids.description: List of cached video row IDs to compare (videos.id ULIDs).

include_channel.description: Whether to include basic channel information for each video in the comparison.

refresh.description: Controls cache refresh behavior: auto refreshes stale/missing, force always refetches, none uses cache only.

max_stale_seconds.description: If provided, treat cached stats older than this as stale and eligible for refresh (when refresh=auto).

metrics.description: Which metrics to return in the comparison; defaults to core statistics if omitted.

sort_by.description: Metric to sort the compared videos by.

tool_schemas.name: listVideos
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached video rows with optional filters and cursor pagination. Returns only cached data and does not fetch from YouTube; use getVideoDetails/getChannelTopVideos/getTrendingVideos to materialize/refresh. Refuses invalid filters or page sizes (VALIDATION_ERROR) and requests without access (UNAUTHORIZED).

channel_id.description: Filter by cached channel row ID (channels.id ULID).

youtube_channel_id.description: Filter by YouTube channel ID; matches videos whose parent channel has this youtube_channel_id.

published_after.description: Return videos published at or after this timestamp.

published_before.description: Return videos published at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: listChannels
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached channel rows with optional filters and cursor pagination. Returns only cached data and does not fetch from YouTube; use getChannelStatistics to refresh statistics when needed. Refuses invalid filters/page sizes (VALIDATION_ERROR) and requests without access (UNAUTHORIZED).

country.description: Filter by 2-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) when present on the channel.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match against title/custom_url when supported.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getVideoById
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single cached video row by its internal row ID (videos.id). Returns the video record as stored (no refresh). Raises NOT_FOUND when the row does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR when the ID is malformed, and UNAUTHORIZED when access is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: updateVideoStatus
tool_schemas.description: Updates the lifecycle status of a cached video row (videos.status) using an allowed transition (active↔unavailable, active/unavailable→deleted). Returns the updated row. Refuses illegal transitions (VALIDATION_ERROR), missing rows (NOT_FOUND), and unauthorized updates (UNAUTHORIZED).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason to record alongside audit/logging (if enabled).

tool_schemas.name: updateChannelStatus
tool_schemas.description: Updates the lifecycle status of a cached channel row (channels.status) using an allowed transition (active↔disabled, active/disabled→deleted). Returns the updated row. Refuses illegal transitions (VALIDATION_ERROR), missing rows (NOT_FOUND), and unauthorized updates (UNAUTHORIZED).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason to record alongside audit/logging (if enabled).

metadata.name: YouTube MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores cached YouTube entities (videos, channels) plus derived analytics (engagement ratios, comparisons) and text assets (transcripts).
